label: Guide me: Reported issues

params.name: lede
params.default: Answer what people report in {product}, or push an issue to CodyFy to be built.
params.label: lede

params.name: steps

default.title: Reported issues
default.say: Everything people report from any screen in {product} lands here: who sent it, from which screen, and what is wrong.

default.title: The queue
default.say: Open, Resolved and All sort the queue. Each row shows the report, where it came from, and any answer already given.

default.title: Push to
default.say: When an issue needs a code change, the portal admin presses Push to on its row.

default.title: The road it takes
default.say: The picture shows the road: this issue becomes a CodyFy request, its build machine writes the change, and a pull request comes back for your review.

default.title: Where it goes
default.say: The card names the company and project it lands in. The first time, press Connect CodyFy, sign in there and press Allow; nothing to copy. After that the card simply says Connected.

default.title: Kind, title and details
default.say: Pick the kind of request. The title and details come from the issue; change them if you like.

default.title: Push
default.say: Press Push. The row then shows the request and its stage, with a link to open it in CodyFy.

params.label: steps: title, say, target (what to light up), open (what to press first)
